item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a credible 2024 source that directly proves Xi or close family profited through assets, contracts, monopolies, bribes, gifts, emoluments, or hidden conflicts. The strongest direct family-enrichment reporting I found is historical, not 2024: ICIJ/Bloomberg reported in 2014 that Xi’s brother-in-law Deng Jiagui used offshore companies. I did not count that as 2024 evidence, but it is the clearest background context for this lens.","evidence":[{"title":"Xi delivers important speech at CCDI plenary session","publisher":"English.www.gov.cn / Xinhua","date":"2024-01-10","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202401/10/content_WS659dd697c6d0868f4e8e2e74.html","summary":"Xi publicly said corruption remained serious in finance, SOEs, energy, medicine, and infrastructure and called for tighter oversight. This is weak positive evidence for trying to police conflicts and rent-seeking inside the system.","question_ids":["7B.4","5B.5"]},{"title":"China to defuse risks in real estate, local gov't debt, small and medium financial institutions","publisher":"English.www.gov.cn / Xinhua","date":"2024-03-05","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/05/content_WS65e67f6ec6d0868f4e8e4a72.html","summary":"The work report openly named real-estate, local-debt, and financial-sector risks to the legislature. That points away from overt favoritism.","question_ids":["7B.4","6B.10"]},{"title":"Beijing orders heavily indebted local governments to halt some unfinished infrastructure projects","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-19","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/exclusivechina-orders-indebted-local-governments-to-halt-some-infrastructure-projectssources-3277972","summary":"Cutting or pausing projects after overborrowing is evidence of correction against politically driven spending and local-capture excesses.","question_ids":["7B.4","6B.5","6B.6"]},{"title":"Growth rises after investigations of connected officials","publisher":"European Journal of Political Economy","date":"2024-06-01","url":"https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S017626802400051X","summary":"The paper finds growth rose after investigations of connected officials, consistent with anti-rent enforcement having real economic effects. That suggests anti-corruption also functioned as loyalty enforcement, not just neutral conflict-of-interest control.","question_ids":["7B.4","5B.5","7B.2"]},{"title":"China targets financial sector with Party-led anti-graft committee","publisher":"Reuters / MarketScreener","date":"2024-07-24","url":"https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-targets-financial-sector-with-party-led-anti-graft-committee-47453350/","summary":"Reuters reported a new financial-sector anti-graft committee with political supervision and “party building” duties, showing finance was still governed through Party control rather than insulated rules.","question_ids":["7B.4","5B.5","6B.9"]},{"title":"RFA closes Hong Kong bureau after security-law expansion","publisher":"Radio Free Asia","date":"2024-03-29","url":"https://www.rfa.org/english/news/china/rfa-bureau-closure-03292024133320.html/","summary":"The closure of an independent bureau after Article 23 expansion shows the state was shrinking scrutiny into political and financial power, which makes hidden conflicts harder to detect.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.2","6B.9"]},{"title":"Hong Kong national security trial for 47 democrats","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-30","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/hong-kongs-landmark-national-security-trial-for-47-democrats-3462427","summary":"Long pretrial detention, bail denial, a juryless trial, and mass convictions show courts being used for political punishment rather than neutral enforcement. That is indirect evidence that any abuse of office would be hard to investigate outside Party control.","question_ids":["7B.4","6B.9"]},{"title":"Official messaging called criticism of Xinjiang “lies” and blamed Western forces","publisher":"PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-02-19","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjbzhd/202402/t20240219_11246993.html","summary":"Beijing rejected criticism as false information and blamed outside forces. This is not direct enrichment evidence, but it is consistent with a system that suppresses scrutiny of possible conflicts of interest.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.2"]}]}
